description: This file defines a static class 'ReferenceCodec' that provides methods for serializing and deserializing object references within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing references, handling null references, reading references, and recording object references during serialization sessions.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks the current session as having a value field, indicating that the next value is a value type.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceFieldExpected
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value that has already been serialized, suitable for static codecs with known expected type.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value, including expected and actual types, if the value has been tracked.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField
methods.description: Overload that includes actual type for reference writing.

methods.name: ReadReference
methods.description: Reads a reference value, returning null if the reference is zero.

methods.name: ReadReference
methods.description: Reads a reference value given a specific field type.

methods.name: DeserializeFromMarker
methods.description: Deserializes an object from a marker, handling session state and reference IDs.

methods.name: RecordObject
methods.description: Records an object as read or written in the session.

methods.name: RecordObject
methods.description: Records an object with a specific reference ID.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder reference ID for objects that cannot be deserialized immediately.
